brief_details.what: Confined space incident - oxygen deficiency in wastewater treatment sludge storage tank. Maintenance technician entered tank without permit or atmosphere testing and collapsed at 3m depth. Two rescue attempts by untrained personnel resulted in two additional casualties. All three victims suffered hypoxia and were rescued by fire department with SCBA equipment.
brief_details.where: DEF Wastewater Treatment Facility, Sludge Storage Tank #3 (5m diameter, 8m depth), DEF Environmental Technologies Inc.
brief_details.who: Victim 1: Ahmet Çelik (29, Maintenance Technician) - CRITICAL condition with hypoxia and brain damage risk; Victim 2: Hasan Öztürk (42, Shift Supervisor) - SEVERE condition with hypoxia and head trauma from fall; Victim 3: Kemal Aydın (35, Operator) - MODERATE condition with mild hypoxia. Fire department rescue team performed extraction.
brief_details.emergency_measures: 10:37 - Emergency services (112) and fire department called; 10:40 - Facility emergency notification issued; 10:55 - Fire department entered tank with SCBA; 11:00-11:05 - Three victims extracted from tank; 11:10 - CPR administered to all three victims; 11:20 - All three transported to hospital by ambulance. Atmosphere testing post-rescue revealed O2 at 11% (critical deficiency), H2S at 45ppm (toxic), CH4 at 2.1%, CO at 15ppm.
